title: In-Context Learning Before Specialisation: Theory of Learning in a Solvable Topic Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.21901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequence models can generalise in fundamentally distinct ways: extrapolating structures seen in training, or using their prompt to adapt to novel tasks. The prevailing strategy determines how the model behaves beyond its training distribution, controlling potential capabilities and risks. Recent work has characterised many different strategies theoretically, and empirically described the transition between them as the quality and quantity of pretraining data vary. However, there is no learning theory for this competition, hence no fundamental understanding of \textit{why} one solution might be favoured over another. Here we provide such a theory in a solvable topic model---documents drawn from a finite mixture of latent topics, mirroring the heterogeneity of modern pretraining data. The dataset comes with two distinct solutions: a specialised predictor, that stores the finite topic mixture, and an in-context one, optimal for topics nev

translated_title: 专业化之前的上下文学习：可解主题模型中的学习理论
translated_abstract: 序列模型可以通过两种根本不同的方式进行泛化：一是外推训练中已经见过的结构，二是利用其提示来适应全新的任务。模型采取的策略决定了其在训练分布之外的行为方式，从而控制着潜在的能力与风险。近期的工作已在理论上刻画了多种不同的策略，并从实证角度描述了随着预训练数据质量与数量的变化，这些策略之间如何发生转变。然而，目前尚无针对这种竞争关系的学习理论，因此无法从根本上理解为什么一种解会比另一种解更受青睐。我们在一个可解的主题模型中提供了这样的理论——文档从有限的潜在主题混合分布中抽取，以此反映现代预训练数据的异质性。该数据集存在两种截然不同的解：一种是专门化预测器，它存储了有限的主题混合结构；另一种是上下文解，对于从未见过的主题而言是最优的。
tldr: 该论文在一个可解的主题模型中建立了学习理论，从根本层面解释了序列模型为何以及何时会倾向于采用上下文学习而非存储训练数据的专门化外推。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a learning theory for a solvable topic model, fundamentally explaining when and why sequence models favour in-context learning over specialised extrapolation of the training data.
